# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please email **privacy@built2bid.org** with "Security" in the subject line. Include the affected page or endpoint,
steps to reproduce, and the impact you observed. Do not include real customer data.

- We acknowledge reports within 2 business days and give a status update within 7 days.
- Please do not access, change or delete data that is not yours, run denial-of-service or volume tests, or use
  social engineering. Good-faith research that follows these rules will not be pursued legally.
- Please give us a reasonable time to fix an issue before disclosing it publicly.

Machine-readable contact: https://built2bid.org/.well-known/security.txt
Public security overview: https://built2bid.org/security

## Supported versions

Only the current production deployment (https://built2bid.org, built from `main`) is supported.
